hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` mkdir resources
aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/columnMeta/columnMeta.csv data/columnMeta.csv aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/resources/Managed_Inputs.csv data/Managed_Inputs.csv aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/hrmn/decoded_data/hrmn_metadata.json data/hrmn_metadata.json
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN mkdir DCC mkdir DCC/output grep "^\"*\\\\DCC Harmonized data set\\\\" data/columnMeta.csv > DCC/subset_columnmeta.csv
java -jar jars/ConceptInputFileGenerator.jar --subsetDir "./DCC/" --ref "DCC Harmonized data set" export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` aws s3 rm s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/newDictionary/DCC/ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*.csv' aws s3 cp ./DCC/output/ s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/newDictionary/DCC/ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*.csv' unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
datasetRef="DCC Harmonized data set" abv="TOPMed_Harmonized" fullName="Trans-Omics for Precision Medicine (TOPMed) Harmonized Phenotypes" desc="Phenotype harmonization was conducted to enable cross-study analyses. The main goals of this process are to provide harmonized phenotypes that are well-documented, reproducible, and as homogeneous across studies as possible." curl --retry 5 --max-time 10 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 0 --show-error --silent --request PUT \ --data-urlencode "datasetRef=${datasetRef}" --data-urlencode "abv=${abv}" \ --data-urlencode "fullName=${fullName}" --data-urlencode "desc=${desc}" ${api}/dataset \ || { echo 'dataset curl failed' ; exit 255;}
csvgrep -c "DCC Harmonized" -m "Yes" data/Managed_Inputs.csv | csvgrep -c "Data is ready to process" -m "Yes" | csvcut -c "Study Identifier" | csvformat -E > hrmn_studies.csv while read study_id do echo "$study_id is harmonized, adding to harmonization table" curl --request PUT --data-urlencode "sourceDatasetRef=${study_id}" --data-urlencode "harmonizedDatasetRef=${datasetRef}" "${api}/dataset/harmonization" done < hrmn_studies.csv
curl --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-binary @"DCC/output/concepts.csv" "${api}/concept/csv?datasetRef=DCC%20Harmonized%20data%20set" || exit 255
jq '.' data/hrmn_metadata.json | jq 'group_by(.concept_path) | map(.[0])' > data/hrmn_output.json || exit 255 curl --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/json' \ --data @data/hrmn_output.json "${api}/concept/curated?datasetRef=DCC%20Harmonized%20data%20set" || exit 255
